text:
maria.g: Incoming external assessment from SecCheck Labs scheduled Tue 09:00 PT. Need to confirm onboarding checklist: KMS access window, RBAC temporary roles, S3 log export method, and retest window. Assessor requests access to audit logs (auth/authz), and a sample of service logs for 72h.

jordan.k: we can provide ephemeral KMS key material via a signed export. prefer to create a one-off key with limited usage and rotate after the window. propose 4h access window by default.

kevin_oncall: +1. Also need a temporary assessor RBAC role (assessor.readonly) scoped to the evidence buckets and CloudAudit logs. No write unless explicitly approved. Who owns role creation? @jordan.k or infra team?

maria.g: @jordan.k please create the IAM role and KMS key policy. @kevin_oncall we'll add the oncall for escalation. Assessor name + contact: seccheck@example.com, POC: Lee Tan.

olivia_prod: For logs, assessor asked for full authz audit with principal, action, resource, outcome. We should avoid sharing raw user identifiers; provide pseudonymized principal ids unless legal requires full. Also prefer presigned S3 URLs for bundles rather than long-lived creds.

jordan.k: agreed on presigned. Plan: 1) spin temp bucket with access logs 2) put exports in folder 3) hand over presigned GET that expires after 24h 4) rotate KMS key and retire. Here's the minimal IAM policy snippet for the role:

```json
{
  \"Version\": \"2012-10-17\",
  \"Statement\": [
    {\"Effect\": \"Allow\", \"Action\": [\"s3:GetObject\", \"s3:ListBucket\"], \"Resource\": [\"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*\"]},
    {\"Effect\": \"Allow\", \"Action\": [\"kms:Decrypt\", \"kms:GenerateDataKey\"], \"Resource\": [\"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-temp-key\"]}
  ]
}
```

kevin_oncall: good. For RBAC changes we'll do ephemeral role binding via SCIM or our idp on the day. Add an expiration tag so it auto-uncouples. Also create an audit hook to log role grant events to the evidence bucket.

maria.g: remediation tracking: we'll use the tracked spreadsheet and label each finding with id e.g., SC-2026-001, severity (P0/P1/P2), owner, ETA, status. Assessor asked for retest window availability within 2 weeks of fixes.

olivia_prod: suggest we lock retest window slots now: Tue+Thu mornings for the next 3 weeks. @maria.g can you confirm org-level approvals for ephemeral KMS usage? Legal/compliance needs to sign the data sharing addendum.

maria.g: legal already signed NDA but we'll attach the addendum. I'm adding a checklist: 1) Create assessor role w/ expiry 2) Create temp KMS key + policy 3) Export audit logs -> bucket 4) Provide presigned URLs + manifest 5) Tag findings in tracker and assign owners 6) Schedule retest slots 7) Post-retest evidence upload and key rotation.

jordan.k: I'll create keys/roles today, will post ARN and presigned link in this thread once ready. ETA EOD.

kevin_oncall: I'll prep the oncall runbook snippet for any escalations during assessment. Keep the blast radius low; no production writes.

pt_assessor_bot: SecCheck Labs intake received. Reminder: please upload evidence manifest to the shared bucket and include checksum file (sha256).

maria.g: action items assigned: @jordan.k -> role+kms; @kevin_oncall -> runbook + role audit hook; @olivia_prod -> data-handling guidance + presigned bucket; I'll coordinate retest scheduling and legal addendum.

olivia_prod: quick Q - do we want to pseudonymize principal ids before export? some teams prefer raw. My call: pseudonymize by default, provide mapping only if compliance requests.

jordan.k: pseudonymize default. We'll record mapping in a sealed artifacts folder and only release by request.

kevin_oncall: fine. Also add a short note in the tracker for escalation SLAs (response within 4h for P0 during the window).

maria.g: perfect. I'll update tracker and DM seccheck POC with the presigned link once posted. Thanks all :thumbsup:

pt_assessor_bot: Scheduled reminder posted: assessment kickoff Tue 09:00 PT.
